Биотин.about: Vitamin B7: useful only in cases of deficiency; in healthy people it has not been proven for hair/nails; distorts analyses.
Биотин.caution: Biotin (vitamin B7, vitamin H). There are NO systematic reviews or meta-analyses on clinical effects in healthy people. Biotin deficiency is rare (only with genetic diseases, long-term parenteral nutrition, consumption of raw egg whites). In healthy people with normal levels - supplements have no proven effect on hair/nails/skin. Side effects: distortion of laboratory tests (troponin, thyroid hormones).
effects: Hair/nails only in case of deficiency; interferes with analyzes
Биотин.food_sources: Eggs, liver, nuts, legumes, milk; Deficiency is unlikely with a normal diet.
Биотин.guidelines: MA 2022 (5 RCT, 445): TC −0.22 significant, glucose/TG on the borderline, insulin without effect. Risk: Immunoassay bias.
Биотин.how_to_choose: 30-100 mcg/day with food; 48 hours before thyroid/troponin tests, cancel; on hair - only in case of deficiency.

interactions.note: distorts the results, stop in 3 days

Биотин.myths: “For hair and nails for everyone” - only in case of shortage. “Harmless in any dose” - distorts immunoassays (thyroid, troponin).
